unknown_field:
A :: struct { value: s32; }
Answer :: () { result := ifx true then A.{value=1} else .{missing=2}; }
field_type:
A :: struct { value: s32; }
Answer :: () { result := ifx true then A.{value=1} else .{value="wrong"}; }
enum:
A :: enum { One; Two; }
Answer :: () { result := ifx true then A.{} else .{}; }
recursive:
A :: struct { value: s32; }
Answer :: () { result := ifx true then result else A.{value=2}; }
global:
A :: struct { value: s32; }
result := ifx true then A.{value=1} else .{value=2};
